ModMetaData.name: Immersive Raid Compression
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces oversized late-game human raids, mechanoid raids, manhunter packs, mech cluster defenders, and ordinary infestations without hidden stat buffs. Ordinary infestations keep every vanilla tunnel and hive, replace only the initial insect composition with stronger vanilla insect kinds, preserve every insect kind selected by the vanilla algorithm, retain 95–105% combat power, and distribute the compressed force across the infestation area. Ordinary human edge assaults use same-role vanilla promotion. Oversized ordinary pirate edge assaults can additionally become two or three role-balanced, point-qualified waves; reinforcements use safe vanilla drop pods near surviving attackers, fall back to the original edge arrival when necessary, and join the original raid Lord. Siege, sapper, breach, center-drop, and multi-front pirate raids remain excluded from phasing. Ordinary tribal raids can promote warriors only to higher-tier PawnKinds already present in that faction's active vanilla group maker, preserving tribal technology, xenotypes, and roles; potential sapper-capable warriors are compressible only outside actual sapper or breach strategies. Edge-walk sieges compress only ordinary combat PawnKind selections while leaving the vanilla LordJob_Siege and siege workflow untouched. Edge-walk sapper and breach raids retain every original path-opening specialist and at least 75% of ordinary escorts. Center and random human drop raids keep the resolved vanilla drop worker and at least 80% of the original pawn count. Grouped and distributed human arrivals keep the resolved vanilla multi-front worker and at least 90% of the original pawn count; runtime proof verifies distinct map-edge approaches remain. Unknown special human arrivals remain protected. Homogeneous pure-role mechanoid swarms using vanilla edge-walk or edge-drop arrival can enter in two or three controlled waves as active combat power falls. Later waves use vanilla drop pods near surviving original attackers, but only on validated cells outside player-pawn, player-building, home-area, roof, and fog exclusion zones; when no complete safe cluster exists they fall back to the original edge arrival. Phasing starts only above a configurable count threshold; every wave must clear a dynamic point floor and weak tails are merged. Reinforcements join the original raid Lord and share its live wait/attack state. Mixed forces use same-role vanilla promotion and may very rarely promote at most one boss only from the current vanilla group maker's weighted pool. Deferred pawns and exact qualified wave plans are saved. The audit page shows classification, per-wave points, arrival and state-inheritance proof.
通过原版高阶单位替换或安全分批减少后期单位数，不添加隐藏属性 Buff。普通虫族感染完整保留原版隧道与虫巢，只把初始虫群替换成更高价值的原版虫种；原版算法选中的每种虫族至少保留一只，总战斗力保持在 95%–105%，压缩后的虫群分散在整片感染区域。普通人类边缘正面袭击使用同职责原版晋升。规模过大的普通海盗边缘强攻还可分成两批或三批职责均衡且达到点数下限的部队；增援在存活海盗附近使用安全的原版空投舱，必要时回退到原边缘入场，并加入原袭击 Lord。围城、工兵、破墙、中心空投和多线海盗袭击不参与分批。普通部落袭击只会晋升为当前派系活动原版编队生成器中已有的高阶 PawnKind，保持部落科技、异种与战斗职责；只有在真正的工兵或破墙策略中，具备潜在工兵能力的战士才按开路专家保护。边缘步入的围城袭击只压缩普通战斗人员，原版 LordJob_Siege 与围城流程不变。边缘步入的工兵和破墙袭击逐个保留原有开路专家，并至少保留 75% 的普通护卫。人类中心空投和随机分散空投继续使用原版空投 Worker，并至少保留原人数的 80%。分组及环绕分散入场继续使用原版多线 Worker，并至少保留原人数的 90%；运行测试验证压缩后仍存在多个地图边缘进攻方向。未知特殊入场继续保持原版。单一职责机械海超过数量门槛后只分为两批或三批，每批必须达到动态点数下限。后续批次使用原版空投舱降落在原袭击存活单位附近，但落点必须避开玩家小人、玩家建筑、Home 区、屋顶和战争迷雾；整批找不到安全落点便回退到原版边缘入场。增援加入原袭击 Lord，继承其当前等待/进攻状态。混编只进行同职责原版晋升，并且仅从当前原版编队生成器自身的加权候选池极低概率晋升最多一个头目。待增援单位与精确波次计划写入存档，记录页面显示分类、每批点数、入场方式与状态继承证明。
